title: Spatial and time partial derivatives of a family that is jointly C^n on an open set are C^m there (m + 1 ≤ n)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ → ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ, let O ⊆ ℝ × ℝᴺ be open, and let m, n ∈ WithTop ℕ∞ (smoothness exponents) satisfy m + 1 ≤ n. Suppose (t,x) ↦ Φ t x is C^n on O (ContDiffOn ℝ n). Then the spatial derivative (t,x) ↦ fderiv ℝ (Φ t) x and the time derivative (t,x) ↦ deriv (s ↦ Φ s x) t are both C^m on O.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (Φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N) (O : Set (ℝ × Rn N)) (m n : WithTop ℕ∞), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ Φ p.1 p.2) O → m + 1 ≤ n → ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ fderiv ℝ (Φ p.1) p.2) O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ deriv (fun s ↦ Φ s p.2) p.1) O
